lines: d36: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Elias Cheng is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d36: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d36: 🕯️ Elias is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d36: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d36: 🕯️ Elias Cheng is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d36: What Elias kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d36: "Elias's gone." Dzigbordi looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Elias." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d36: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Minh blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d36: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d36: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d36: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d36: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Elias Cheng, 36 days. The mantle passes to Minh Robles.
d36: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Minh Robles, 24 — a Midwife. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Fusion Reactor, Lucky Rock, Cold-Blooded, Feast Engine.
d36: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Furnace of the Unkillable." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d36: The village's quarrel was with Elias — and Elias is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d36: At the grave, Nathan, Aidan, Dzigbordi and 4 more speak for Minh — "Elias trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d36: The fire knew Minh before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
